name: Coronoid Process Fracture
definition: Fracture of the ulnar coronoid process, an important stabilizer of the elbow, frequently associated with dislocation or terrible-triad injury.

investigations.principle: Radiographs and CT define fragment size/location and associated injuries.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, cartilage, occult injury, postoperative or other condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific diagnostic pathway.

amber: Fixation depends on fragment pattern and overall elbow stability.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Kurpara-bhagna/Sandhi instability phenotype may be documented.

patientEducation.summary: Fracture of the ulnar coronoid process, an important stabilizer of the elbow, frequently associated with dislocation or terrible-triad injury.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute neurovascular compromise, major trauma, respiratory distress, progressive neurological deficit, open injury, severe deformity, infection or other listed red flags.
